meta.title: Afterhours Drop 03 — Last Train, 12 December 2026
meta.description: Launch deck for Afterhours Drop 03, a nightwear capsule for people who work late: the sold-out frustration, the Last Train jacket, three features, Drop 02 proof, prices and a 23:00 release.

slides.heading: Drop 03 is made for the last train home.
slides.notes: Lights low. Read the line slowly; the room should hear 'last train' twice by the end.

slides.quote: Drop 02 sold out before my shift ended. I never even saw the page.

slides.heading: Last Train: a black jacket that glows under platform lights
slides.lead: Reflective pink script across the back. Invisible by day.

slides.heading: Made for the walk home
slides.lead: Three things Drop 03 does after midnight.

slides.heading: The script reflects headlights from 150 metres away
slides.body: 3M reflective thread, stitched, not printed. It survives 60 washes.

slides.heading: Codes go out by SMS at 23:00, after most shifts end
slides.lead: No 10 a.m. queue. One code per phone number.

slides.body: Five launch nights on 13 December: London, Berlin, Lisbon, Seoul, New York.

slides.heading: Drop 02 sold all 900 pieces in 11 minutes

slides.quote: Afterhours dresses the people who keep our clubs running, and they actually wear it.

slides.heading: 1,500 pieces go live at 23:00 local, from $25
Stay up for 23:00, and ride the last train home in Drop 03.
